content2.content: Flutter is all about widgets. Understanding how to compose them effectively is key to writing clean code.

content4.content: Instead of extending existing widgets to add functionality, wrap them in other widgets. For example, wrap a `Text` in a `Padding` instead of subclassing `Text`.

content6.content: Break down large build methods into smaller, separate widgets. This improves readability and performance (if using `const`).

content9.content: Small, focused widgets are easier to test, reuse, and maintain.
